# Templates (Cin7 Core API v2)

Group `Templates` of the Cin7 Core API reference. Base URL `https://inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalApi/v2/`; every request carries the `api-auth-accountid` and `api-auth-applicationkey` headers (see `../api-basics.md`). 1 actions on 1 resources, 1 field tables.

| Action | Path |
|---|---|
| [GET](#get-ref-templates) | `GET /ref/templates?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Type={Type}&Name={Name}` |


Templates CRUD operations

### Available Fields for Templates
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `TemplateID`  | GUID           |         |          |Unique Template Id.        |
| `Type`  | String             |         |          |Template type.      |
| `Name`  | String             |         |          |Template name       |
| `EmailSubject`  | String             |         |          |Email Subject for template. |
| `CustomEmail`  | String             |         |          | BCC Address field for Template form.      |

## Templates

Path: `/ref/templates`

<a id="get-ref-templates"></a>
### GET /ref/templates?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Type={Type}&Name={Name}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Type` (optional, string): Only return templates with the specific Type
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return templates with the specific Name
